thread:
sre-bot: ALERT: Canary cluster eu-west-1 for prompt-routing v2 is showing a spike in 5xxs and tail latency. 5m error rate 12% (baseline 0.3%). Auto-notifying on-call. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/ops/canary?panel=prompt_mux

deploy-bot: Deploy id=ci-2026-03-15-4123 rolled out prompt_mux_v2 to 10% canary 12:14Z. Linked PR: https://git.redwood/rls/4321
jordan: I'm on it. Paging primary oncall (jordan) — taking ownership. Starting initial triage.
ashley: I see the same in logs: KV cache miss rate doubled and "invalid-kv-shard" errors for a subset of requests. Throwing 503s. Query: which variant is failing, mux->direct or mux->proxy?
mike: Looks like requests routed to new-endpoint /v2/prompt/new-endpoint are returning 5xx from runtime (segfault-like traces). Pulling runtime logs.
ashley: Pasting tail of runtime logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:16:04Z] runtime: panic: kv cache shard nil
goroutine 4123 [running]:
  github.com/redwood/runtime/kv.(*Shard).Get(...)
  /work/runtime/kv/shard.go:87
```

leila: Product: we have 3 paying customers in the canary cohort (acme-inc, beta-co, partner-x). Notify support. Potentially visible in EU region only.
nora: Notified support channel and opened ticket for ACME. Customer success pinged. Customer-facing status: assessing impact, may need an incident banner.
jordan: Ok, two paths: immediate featuregate kill (snapback to stable mux) or abort canary and roll back deploy. Which is faster?
mike: Featuregate flip is fastest. FF name is featuregate.prompt_mux_v2. I can flip via admin. Command: `redwood-ff set featuregate.prompt_mux_v2 off --env=prod --scope=canary`
ashley: Before flipping — can we confirm no data corruption? KV errors look read-only but need to verify. Also we should capture core dump if any. Sam, can you trigger a core dump grab and upload to S3?
sam: On it. Running `collector grab --pid 4123 --upload s3://incidents/3054321987/`
deploy-bot: NOTE: The rollout automation will attempt to continue unless FF is turned off. Current canary traffic is approx 8% of global.
jordan: I'm going to flip the featuregate now — calling audible. Handoff: @mike you'll lead the post-flip validation. @ashley watch logs. @leila coordinate comms.
jordan: `redwood-ff set featuregate.prompt_mux_v2 off --scope=global --by=jordan --note="emergency snapback: runtime 5xx"`
(reacts :thumbsup:)
mike: Confirmed: command executed, propagation to edge proxies initiated. Watching for routing changes.
ashley: Within 40s I see routes switching back to mux stable. 5xxs dropping. Error rate now 1.4% and trending down.
nora: Support: we have an update for ACME. Triage note: "We observed elevated errors impacting a subset of EU requests between 12:14Z—12:18Z. Engineers reverted the featuregate for the canary and are validating recovery. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for a fix."
leila: Sending incident banner to status.redwood.com draft: "Partial degradation in EU for Prompt Routing — mitigated. Investigating root cause."
sam: Core upload complete: s3://incidents/3054321987/runtime-core-4123.gz (sha256: abc123...). Added to the incident record.
mike: Runtime team snapshot: reproducer script failing on local when KV shard mapping is nil. Suspect mismatch between compiled kernel and model shard layout. Adding to issue: https://git.redwood/bugs/9876
jordan: We have stabilization for now. Next steps: 1) open a rollback PR hold for the rollout (block continuing canary expansion), 2) collect metrics for 30m to confirm no residual errors, 3) schedule a deeper postmortem.
ashley: I'll create a short-run alert to watch for recurrence: alert/ff_prompt_mux_v2_watch -> page if error_rate > 2% for 5m.
leila: Product follow-ups: identify impacted customers (ACME, beta-co, partner-x), propose outreach plan, propose narrower roll strategy (lower concurrency, KV-compat shim).
nora: Support will follow up with ACME once we have postmortem. Customer impact: estimated ~120 failed requests during the window. No data loss reported.
mike: Temporary mitigation: recompile runtime with defensive nil-checks and schedule a quick canary redeploy once validated in staging. Will append CI tests for KV-shard edge cases.
jordan: Handoff: I'll stay on the incident for another 30m and then hand to @ashley for monitoring overnight. If anything spikes, page me again.
ashley: Acknowledged, will monitor and escalate as needed.
sre-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: 3054321987 | severity: high | mitigation: featuregate.snapback (featuregate.prompt_mux_v2 off) | assignee: jordan | ticket: https://redwood.incidents/3054321987
leila: Scheduling postmortem meeting at 2026-03-16 16:00Z. Invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-ml, product, support.
mike: Uploading debug artifacts and minimal repro steps to the incident doc.
jordan: Closing the active pages. Good catch, team. Follow-on: avoid global flip for canary until KV compatibility validated.
support-bot: Customer notify: ACME ticket #INC-1548 updated — initial mitigation applied, we will follow up with root cause and timeline.
(reacts :white_check_mark: from jordan, mike, ashley)
